tools.description: Read the state of the Dry Run vault: balance, rolling 24h caps, approved contracts, freeze state.
tools.name: wallet_status

tools.description: Propose a financial action (transfer or contract call). It is SIMULATED before any signature. The verdict (ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK) and the effects card are returned.

intent.description: Declared intent in plain language (e.g. 'pay 1 NEAR to bob')

tools.name: wallet_propose

tools.description: Freeze the vault immediately with the freeze key. Every later transaction is rejected.
tools.name: wallet_freeze

tools.description: Get the detailed explanation of a Dry Run firewall rule (R1 to R12).
tools.name: wallet_explain
